title: Jewels of Norway with FREE Pulpit Rock Cruise
highlights: Explore Oslo's historic landmarks and modern attractions, including the Oslofjord, Royal Palace, and Vigeland Sculpture Park.
Experience the natural beauty of Norway's fjords with scenic cruises through Lysefjord, Geirangerfjord, and Mostraumen, surrounded by cliffs and waterfalls.
Hike to the famous Pulpit Rock for panoramic views over Lysefjord, and embark on an Arctic nature tour in Tromsø to discover the region's wildlife and landscapes.
Chase the elusive Northern Lights in Tromsø with a thrilling Northern Lights chase by bus, offering the chance to witness the magical auroras.
overview: From scenic cruises to the remote Islands and from the northern lights capital to the world’s steepest railways, Norway is home to numerous natural and human-made wonders. A trip here with your loved one will provide you with multiple entertainment options and a trip you can cherish for a lifetime.
inclusions: Transfer from Oslo Airport, Gardermoen to Deluxe Hotel

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Oslo
days.desc: Start your journey to Norway and as you arrive at Oslo. Upon arrival at Oslo airport, you will get transferred to your hotel in Oslo.  Check-in and spend the day at your own pace. You can explore major landmarks such as the Royal Palace, Akershus Fortress, Oslo City Hall, Oslo Opera House, and the Aker Brygge area. After exploring the place, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day trip of Oslofjord
days.desc: In the morning, head for the Oslo Fjord for an amazing electric cruise. Glide past iconic landmarks such as the Oslo Opera House, Akershus Fortress, and the picturesque Bygdøy Peninsula, each offering a unique perspective on Oslo's maritime heritage and urban development. After the fun-filled day, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Electric Cruise in Oslo Fjord with Audioguide

days.title: Transfer to Stavanger
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Stavanger from Oslo by bus. Upon reaching, get transferred to your hotel and check-in. You can enjoy your day at leisure or explore the beautiful city on your own by visiting some of the famous attractions of the city, like the stunning Valberg Tower and peaceful Stavanger Cathedral, among many more attractions. After an amazing day, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Pulpit Rock Cruise Experience
days.desc: Start your day heading out today for an amazing journey to Pulpit Rock. Reach the pick-up point, Strandkaien, on your own to board the cruise, which will sail along the Lysefjord to the legendary Pulpit Rock. Then, explore the historic Fantahålå and catch sight of seals basking on rocks. Further, admire the beauty of the stunning Hengjanefossen waterfall before you get transferred back to Strandkaien. Afterward, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Fjord Cruise to Lysefjord and Preikestolen from Stavanger

days.title: Transfer to Bergen
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Stavanger Airport for your flight to Bergen. Upon arrival, check-in at the hotel, after which you can explore this beautiful city located between seven mountains on your own by visiting some of its famous places like the serene Julemarked Byparken and the vibrant Bergen Market Square, among many more attractions. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mostraumen Fjord Cruise Experience
days.desc: After you get ready, head out from the hotel to reach the pick-up point, Dreggekaien, on your own to board your cruise to the Mostraumen Fjord. Sail through the borders of Lindås and Osterøy municipalities, covering the four beautiful fjords, namely, Osterfjorden, Radfjorden, Sørfjorden, and Salhusfjorden. Lastly, reach Mostraumen Strait and admire its beauty. After a wonderful day, you will be back to Dreggekaien, from where head to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Fjord Cruise to Osterfjord and Mostraumen from Bergen

days.title: Transfer to Alesund
days.desc: Make your trip more memorable as you make your way to Alesund, the city famous for its Art Nouveau architecture. After you check-out from the hotel, board your pre-booked transfer for Alesund. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later on, you may explore this stunning city by visiting places like the amazing Jugendstilsenteret Museum, beautiful Town Park, among many other attractions. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Geirangerfjord Cruise Experience
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go on a serene journey to Geirangerfjord. Reach the pick-up point, Ålesund rutebilstasjon hurtigbåtkai, on your own and board the cruise. As your catamaran sails by, admire the Seven Sisters and Suitor waterfalls. After you admire the fjord's beauty, enjoy a stopover in the charming village of Geiranger. Later, board the cruise again, making your way back to the meeting point. Head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Fjord cruise from Alesund to Geiranger, Norway

days.title: Transfer to  Trondheim
days.desc: Enjoy a change of scenery as you check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Trondheim, the place known for its Viking heritage. Upon your arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax for sometime. Afterward, you can explore the city on your own by visiting the stunning Tyholttårnet, beautiful Trondheim Harbor, among many more attractions. Later, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Trondheim Walking Tour
days.desc: Take this day to explore Trondheim on a walking tour. With no fixed attraction points to see, enjoy the freedom to stroll through the city from the viewpoint of local guides as you greet them at Olav Tryggvason, the meeting point of your tour. See places like Stiftsgarden and Nidaros Cathedral. Also, roam around the beautiful Bakklandet district, famous for having the world's first bicycle lift, Trampe. After an amazing day, either return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Tromso
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the Bergen Airport for your flight to Tromso. Upon reaching Tromso, get transferred to your hotel for check-in. Later, spend the rest of the day at your own pace. You can visit Tromsofjords, Fjellheisen Cable Car, or Ersfjordbotn. Afterward, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Northern Lights Tour
days.desc: Wake up and get ready for your Northern Lights tour. Experience the amazing aurora borealis on a northern lights tour. Stay cozy by wrapping up in Icelandic wool blankets and enjoy as you admire the display. After the tour, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Northern Lights Tour on a Shared basis

days.title: Day Trip to Arctic Circle
days.desc: Begin your day by heading to the Magic Ice Bar, Tromsø, for your trip to the Arctic Circle. Explore remote wilderness areas, stunning fjords, and picturesque villages while learning about the unique flora, fauna, and cultural heritage of the Arctic. After the tour, get transferred to the pick-up point and then head to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Arctic Nature Tour from Tromso by Minibus on a Shared basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport for your return flight back home.
